The provision authorizes delegation of powers, duties and functions and requires public notice of the Regulator’s delegations. It does not create or list any offence, infraction or penalty.

The provision authorizes officers and their assistants to cross land and establishes civil liability for damage caused by wilful or negligent acts. It does not create or list an offence, infraction, or penalty.
The provision imposes forfeiture to the State of property belonging to an unlawful society, thereby establishing a penalty.
The provision authorizes an officer to request assistance and extends legal protections to persons assisting the officer. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

El artículo tipifica y sanciona el procesamiento, apozamiento, transformación, transporte, comercialización y almacenamiento de recursos hidrobiológicos vedados, así como determinadas actividades con sus productos derivados, con presidio menor en sus grados mínimo a medio.
El artículo crea un catálogo de infracciones gravísimas al enumerar expresamente las conductas que constituyen tales infracciones, incluidas aquellas cuyo deber se establece en otros artículos.
La disposición encarga a un reglamento establecer normas de saneamiento y seguridad; no crea ni enumera conductas punibles ni establece una sanción.

La disposición establece la obligación del comisionista de dejar constancia legal del deterioro o pérdida de las mercaderías y avisar al comitente, pero no tipifica una infracción ni establece una sanción.

The provision makes abandonment of services by any other military member punishable in the specified circumstances, imposing the corresponding penalties from the preceding article reduced by one degree.

El segundo inciso tipifica la comisión de los hechos por imprudencia temeraria o negligencia con infracción de reglamentos y establece penas de presidio menor en su grado mínimo o multa de seis a veinte unidades tributarias mensuales.
El artículo establece requisitos y prohibiciones para la propaganda electoral, pero no tipifica su incumplimiento como delito o infracción ni fija una sanción.

La disposición establece el deber de efectuar la retención judicial de alimentos y el orden de los descuentos, además de regular el pago cuando hay varios empleadores. No tipifica una infracción ni establece una pena o sanción.
La disposición regula la tramitación de las excepciones de cosa juzgada y de transacción y el momento de resolverlas. No crea ni enumera conductas punibles ni establece sanciones.
该条规定全国人民代表大会专门委员会的设立、领导关系及研究、审议和拟订议案的职责，不创设或列举任何可处罚行为或处罚。
The provision defines terms and specifies what constitutes unprofessional conduct for disciplinary purposes. It does not itself create an offence or infraction or prescribe a penalty.
该条规定国家发展生产、厉行节约、改善人民生活和建立社会保障制度的原则，未设定可处罚行为或任何处罚。

La disposición regula la administración de bienes entregados en prenda pretoria, la rendición de cuentas y la aplicación de sus utilidades al crédito. La pérdida del derecho a remuneración por una administración infiel, dolosa o gravemente culpable no constituye una infracción ni una pena creada por este artículo.
本条规定中华人民共和国主席、副主席的选举方式、任职资格和任期，不创设或列举任何违法行为或处罚。
The provision imposes a 30-day duty to notify the requester and provide access where granted. It does not create or list an offence, infraction, or penalty.

This provision lists the powers of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, including legislative, supervisory, appointment, and pardon powers. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe any penalty.
This provision states that state power belongs to the people and describes how they exercise it. It creates no offence, punishable conduct, or penalty.

The provision sets sentencing rules for offenses covered by the five preceding articles, specifying penalties for frustration, attempt, conspiracy, and proposition. It does not itself define or list the underlying punishable conduct.

This provision authorizes people's congresses in ethnic autonomous areas to enact autonomous and separate regulations and specifies approval and filing requirements. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.

This provision establishes the national and local supervisory commissions and specifies their composition, directors’ terms, and legal basis for organization and powers. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.
This provision lists the State Council’s constitutional powers. Its general authority to reward and punish administrative personnel does not define punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
该条规定全国人大代表及全国人大常委会组成人员提出质询案的权利，以及受质询机关答复的义务，未创设或列举任何可处罚行为或处罚。
This provision establishes the basic socialist economic and distribution systems. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe any penalty.

El texto sanciona la oposición al derecho del anterior arrendatario a fijar un aviso de traslado, con multa de un (1) Salario Mínimo Legal Mensual Vigente, impuesta por la Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio.
该条规定中央军事委员会的领导职责、组成、主席负责制及任期，不创设或列举任何可处罚行为，也未规定处罚。
El artículo tipifica la aceptación de cargo, honor, distinción o merced de un Estado en hostilidad, guerra o conflicto armado con Colombia por un colombiano, y establece una multa como sanción.
本条规定地方人大常委会的组成、责任、组成人员的选举和罢免，以及任职不相容限制，未设定或列举可处罚行为及其处罚。

Regula el trámite de peticiones irrespetuosas, oscuras o reiterativas. El rechazo, la devolución y el archivo son consecuencias procedimentales, no sanciones por conductas tipificadas como infracciones.
La disposición establece una regla probatoria sobre las escrituras sociales y los pactos no expresados en ellas; no crea ni enumera conductas punibles ni establece sanciones.
La disposición establece reglas de simplificación y estandarización de providencias y del modelo de contrato; no tipifica conductas punibles ni establece sanciones.
This provision defines when a statement is a compulsory statement. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
Regula la validez y determinación de las asignaciones testamentarias. Tener una asignación por no escrita es una consecuencia civil de invalidez, no una sanción por conducta punible.

La disposición establece reglas procesales sobre la producción, incorporación y valoración de la prueba en el juicio y sus excepciones. No crea ni enumera conductas punibles ni establece una pena o sanción.

La disposición establece la nulidad civil de actos o contratos que carezcan de requisitos legales y distingue entre nulidad absoluta y relativa. No tipifica conductas punibles ni establece penas o infracciones.
This provision authorises the making of regulations. It does not itself create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty; its mention of offences under the Act is only a reference.
Subsection (2) makes paying commission to an unlicensed insurance intermediary in contravention of subsection (1) an offence, punishable on conviction by a fine of up to $10,000.
This provision grants the Minister discretion to confer permanent residence and sets notice, consultation, and publication requirements. It does not create or list any punishable conduct or penalty.
The provision determines an aircraft’s country of registration for the purposes of the Act. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

This provision defines the scope of application of this Part, including what counts as domestic carriage and exemptions for military and certain club-operated flights. It creates no offence, infraction, or penalty.
The provision describes the effect and duration of a weapons-rights deprivation imposed by a sentence. It is a sentencing rule, not a provision creating punishable conduct or prescribing its penalty.

The provision authorizes cancellation of temporary registration based on fitness or a written request from the Secretary for Health. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
This provision defines annuities, dividends, and rent for apportionment purposes. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.

The provision makes failure to comply with a zoning order an offence, punishable by a fine of up to $100 and an additional fine of up to $20 per day for a continuing offence, subject to the stated exceptions.
Cette disposition régit le droit d’amendement parlementaire et la recevabilité financière des propositions et amendements. Elle ne crée aucune infraction ni aucune sanction.
The provision governs delegations of functions and powers, including their form, duration, and proof of authority. It does not create or list any offence, infraction, or penalty.

This section authorises entry-prohibition notices, specifies their grounds and contents, and requires denial of entry. It does not create an offence or prescribe a penalty; its references to offences, imprisonment, and penalties concern grounds for issuing a notice.
La disposición define el objeto y el carácter público del registro mercantil y permite consultar sus libros y archivos. No crea ni enumera conductas punibles ni establece sanciones.

Establece principios de la administración de justicia y una regla sobre los términos procesales. La mención genérica de que su incumplimiento será sancionado no tipifica una infracción ni establece una pena concreta.
This provision establishes income-tax deductions and defines residency and presence in Rarotonga for those deductions. It does not create or list punishable conduct or impose a penalty.
Cette disposition reconnaît le droit d’asile sous condition de respecter les lois de la République. Elle ne crée ni ne liste de conduite punissable ou de sanction.
Cet article institue le Médiateur de la République et définit son indépendance et sa mission. Il ne crée aucune infraction ni aucune sanction.

L’article énumère les objectifs possibles des organisations visées à l’article 124, notamment la coopération contre certaines formes de criminalité. Il ne crée ni ne liste de conduites punissables et ne fixe aucune sanction.
This provision guarantees the right to democratic opposition and allows the President to consult opposition parties on matters of national interest. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.
L’article fixe les principes de l’administration territoriale et interdit la tutelle d’une collectivité sur une autre, sans qualifier cette conduite d’infraction ni prévoir de peine ou de sanction.
Cet article fixe la procédure de dépôt, d’examen et de discussion des projets et propositions de loi devant les chambres. Il ne crée aucune infraction et ne prévoit aucune peine.

Cette disposition impose aux pouvoirs publics de promouvoir la bonne gouvernance et de réprimer la corruption, ainsi qu’à certains responsables de déclarer leurs biens conformément à la loi. Elle ne crée ni ne liste de conduite punissable et ne prévoit aucune peine.

Le texte garantit l’inamovibilité et l’indépendance des magistrats et encadre les conditions de leur sanction disciplinaire. Il ne crée ni ne liste de conduite punissable ou de peine ; il mentionne seulement des sanctions dans le cadre de garanties statutaires.

The article expressly prohibits child labour and declares it punishable by law, including employing a child in activities that endanger the child or harm their health, growth, or physical and mental well-being.
Cette disposition définit la composition du Gouvernement et sa mission de mise en œuvre de la politique nationale. Elle ne crée ni infraction ni sanction.
Article 244 lists specified forms of assault, resistance, and obstruction, declares them misdemeanours, and makes them punishable by two years’ imprisonment.

Subsections (1) and (2) expressly criminalize soliciting and harassing people in public places to accept or reject specified commercial services or products, including liability for persons on whose behalf or for whose benefit this occurs. They prescribe up to six months’ imprisonment, a fine of €2,000, or both.
Article 52 creates a felony for administering, attending and consenting to, or voluntarily taking an oath binding a person to commit an offence punishable by death. It prescribes life imprisonment.

La disposición establece el contenido y los requisitos formales de la declaración de renta. Solo menciona las sanciones como parte de la liquidación cuando corresponda; no crea ni enumera conductas sancionables ni fija una penalidad.

This provision guarantees freedom of movement, residence and departure, subject to lawful restrictions. It merely mentions restrictions imposed as a penalty by a competent court; it does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
Article 69 expressly makes acts of piracy an offence punishable by life imprisonment and lists the conduct constituting piracy.

The provision defines acts constituting high treason, including armed hostilities against the Republic, assistance to opposing countries or forces, and overthrowing the lawful government by force, and prescribes life imprisonment.

Section 51A(1) creates a misdemeanor for publicly inciting violence or mutual discord among inhabitants, or fostering intolerance. It prescribes twelve months’ imprisonment, a fine of one thousand pounds, or both; for a legal person, a fine of three thousand pounds.

Article 135 authorizes the Supreme Constitutional Court to issue procedural rules governing court proceedings, jurisdiction, pleadings, court fees and costs, and court staff. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

The provision creates a criminal offence of circulating an officially issued document belonging to another person while falsely impersonating the person named in it, punishable as if the document had been forged.
The provision prohibits torture and inhuman or degrading punishment or treatment as a constitutional guarantee. It does not define an offence or prescribe a penalty.

The provision governs maintenance orders following conviction under Article 182 and enforcement of unpaid maintenance, including collection and imprisonment procedures. It does not itself create or list an offence; these are sentencing and enforcement rules.

The decree amends sickness and maternity benefit rules and sets its effective date. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty; the reference to serving a prison sentence merely concerns returning to work for benefit purposes.
The regulation only amends which previously imposed penalties are entered in the criminal register and disclosed in extracts. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.

The provision creates the criminal offence of public nuisance: causing loud noises or offensive or unhealthy odours that disturb a substantial number of people in exercising their common rights. It expressly states that the offender commits this offence and is punishable accordingly.

The decree sets flat-rate costs of criminal proceedings, varying according to the proceedings and expert involvement. These are procedural costs, not penalties, and the text creates or lists no punishable conduct.
The provision permits tenants under certain leases to pay rent monthly instead of at longer contractual intervals and sets an effective date. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.

The law amends conditions for completion of insolvency debt relief and provides transitional and effective-date rules. It mentions contractual penalties only to classify claims arising before adulthood; it creates no punishable conduct or penalty.
The decree only amends medical criteria and documentation requirements for spa rehabilitation care and sets its effective date. It creates or lists no punishable conduct or penalties.

Čl. I nahrazuje § 17 a přímo stanoví pokuty za porušení cenových předpisů podle § 15: ve výši neoprávněně získaného majetkového prospěchu, přesáhne-li 1 000 000 Kč, nebo do výše 1 000 000 Kč v ostatních uvedených případech.

The provision amends foster carers’ monthly remuneration, sets a limit on children entrusted to one carer, and specifies an effective date. It does not create or list any offence, infraction, or penalty.

The provision governs the King's power to grant pardons and amnesty, requiring Parliament's consent to pardon ministers for punishments imposed by the Court of Impeachment. It neither creates punishable conduct nor establishes a penalty.

Cet article garantit la liberté d’entreprise et prévoit la protection de l’épargne, des capitaux et des investissements. Il ne crée ni ne répertorie de conduite punissable et ne prévoit aucune sanction.

The provision sets maximum reimbursement amounts for employers creating jobs for graduates or young people and specifies its effective date. It does not create or list punishable conduct or impose any penalty.
The law extends the deadline for proving ownership, specifies how ownership and property shares are established, and sets its effective date. It creates no offence, infraction, or penalty.
Section 60 a expressly makes failure by businesses to comply with an order to submit material within the specified deadlines punishable by a fine, including further fines until compliance.

Section 71 establishes constitutional protections for personal liberty and procedural rules for detention and judicial review. It neither creates punishable conduct nor prescribes a penalty; subsection 5 merely mentions existing penalties when limiting pretrial detention.

The provision imposes a confidentiality duty and provides exceptions for disclosure. It refers to liability under specified Criminal Code sections but does not itself create or list an offence or prescribe a penalty.
The regulation only increases a state contribution from CZK 39,600 to CZK 43,560 and sets its effective date. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.

The provision sets eligibility requirements for membership of the Folketing, including disqualification based on a prior conviction, and exempts elected civil servants from needing government permission. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

The provision requires the exercise of judicial power to be regulated by law and prohibits establishing special courts with judicial authority. It does not create or list an offence, infraction, or penalty.

The law amends procedural, scope, and deadline rules. Its military-rank removal provision is a consequential measure following penalties imposed under other provisions, not an independent definition or catalogue of punishable conduct.
The provision states that members of Parliament are bound only by their convictions, not by instructions from their voters. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.

The provision sets grounds and deadlines for extraordinary reassessment of tax liabilities or refunds. Intentional or grossly negligent misstatements are grounds for reassessment under subsection 1(3), but the text does not create an offence or impose a penalty.
Cette disposition fixe une règle de recevabilité des propositions de loi et des amendements ayant des conséquences financières. Elle ne crée aucune infraction ni aucune peine.
The provision sets procedural rules for the composition, voting, delegation, and rules of procedure of the Landsskatteretten. It neither creates punishable conduct nor prescribes a penalty.
The provision authorizes the King to submit proposals for laws and other decisions to Parliament. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
Cette disposition fixe une règle de recevabilité des amendements au projet de loi de finances. Elle ne crée aucune infraction et ne prévoit aucune peine.
This article establishes the legislative procedure for adopting bills and resolving disagreements between the two Chambers. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.

Section 60 directly criminalizes intentionally or grossly negligently providing incorrect or misleading information, or withholding information, for calculating cost reimbursement, punishable by a fine. Subsection 2 provides a fine or imprisonment for up to 1 year and 6 months when committed with intent to obtain reimbursement unlawfully.

This provision establishes the judicial hierarchy and the Court of Cassation’s jurisdiction, including over offences committed by specified officials. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision sets procedural requirements for obtaining binding tax rulings, requiring multiple parties to request the ruling in specified cases. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.
L’article 189 fixe des critères pour les effectifs et les fonctions de commandement, sans créer ni énumérer d’infraction ou de sanction.

L’article organise les lois de finances et les procédures budgétaires. La démission réputée du Gouvernement en cas de dépôt tardif du budget est une conséquence constitutionnelle, non une infraction ou une peine.

The provision prohibits organizing military or paramilitary formations or private militias, or maintaining armed youth, and expressly makes that conduct punishable as high treason (« sous peine de haute trahison »).
L’article 74 fixe le délai d’entrée en fonction du Président élu et le serment qu’il doit prêter. Il ne crée ni ne liste aucune infraction ou sanction.
This provision governs the convening and closure of extraordinary parliamentary sessions. It creates no offence, infraction, or penalty.
El artículo tipifica dos contravenciones de segunda clase y establece para ambas una pena privativa de libertad de cinco a diez días.
El artículo tipifica la imposición de contribuciones arbitrarias con ocasión y en desarrollo de un conflicto armado y establece una pena privativa de libertad de cinco a siete años.

This provision establishes the Constitutional Court’s criminal jurisdiction over the President, Prime Minister, and their co-perpetrators or accomplices. It mentions offences to define that jurisdiction but does not itself create punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

El artículo tipifica conductas relacionadas con la adopción ilegal y establece una pena privativa de libertad de diez a trece años, incluida la inducción a entregar a una niña, niño o adolescente eludiendo los procedimientos legales de acogimiento o adopción.
La disposición establece la división del residuo por mitades entre los cónyuges tras las deducciones; no tipifica conductas punibles ni establece sanciones.
El artículo tipifica conductas que causan daños graves al suelo y establece una pena privativa de libertad de tres a cinco años, con aplicación del máximo en determinadas circunstancias agravantes.

La disposición regula obligaciones civiles del usufructuario, incluida la indemnización al propietario por pérdidas imputables a su hecho o culpa. No crea infracciones ni establece sanciones punitivas.

El artículo tipifica la tortura y establece penas de prisión de siete a diez años, o de diez a trece años en circunstancias agravantes. También sanciona con cinco a siete años al servidor público competente que omita evitarla.
El artículo establece directamente la sanción para una persona jurídica responsable de trata: multa de cien a mil salarios básicos unificados y extinción de la persona jurídica.
La disposición permite el reconocimiento parcial de una obra cuando se ha acordado aprobarla por partes; no establece conductas punibles ni sanciones.

The provision makes breaches of controller or processor obligations under specified GDPR articles punishable by a fine of up to €10,000,000. For legal persons, it sets a maximum of €10,000,000 or 2% of the preceding financial year's worldwide annual turnover, whichever is greater.
La disposición regula el precio del transporte de una mujer que da a luz durante el viaje; no crea ni enumera conductas punibles ni establece una sanción.
La disposición establece la aplicación de las reglas de prescripción a entidades públicas y particulares; no crea ni enumera conductas punibles ni establece penas.
The provision governs the archiving, deletion, access, and informational status of register data. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision regulates sending election documents to eligible voters abroad and selecting the relevant candidate list. It creates no offence, infraction, or penalty.

The provision specifies information that a data controller must provide to a data subject and circumstances permitting delayed, restricted, or omitted disclosure. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty; references to offences and enforcement of punishment are grounds for restricting disclosure.
Article 203 lists matters within the concurrent competence of the central government and provinces. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe any penalty.
L’article 72 énonce uniquement les conditions d’éligibilité à la présidence de la République. Il ne crée ni ne liste de conduite punissable ou de peine.
Establece una obligación de indemnización y menciona la persecución penal por delitos cometidos, pero no crea ni enumera conductas punibles ni fija una pena.
The provision establishes the right to protection by the state and law, including protection against arbitrary state power. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.
The provision specifies which treaties the Riigikogu ratifies and denounces. It creates no punishable conduct and prescribes no penalty.
The provision governs changes to the appointed Government’s composition by the President on the Prime Minister’s proposal. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.

The provision sets out the data protection officer’s duties, an exception for courts’ judicial activities, and a requirement to avoid conflicts of interest. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

This provision regulates the submission and review of complaints by the National Electoral Committee, including deadlines, possible decisions, and notification. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.

This provision establishes evidentiary and procedural rules for statements and admissions used to assess benefits from unlawful activity and amounts recoverable under a pecuniary penalty order. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision governs the appointment and obligations of an authorised data processor. It establishes duties but does not create or list an offence, infraction, or penalty.

The provision establishes procedures for authorising interception of communications and admitting intercepted information as evidence. It refers to offences under the Act but does not itself create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision establishes an evidentiary rule for admitting certificates and treating them as proof in proceedings. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
This provision classifies existing offences as non-political for extradition purposes. It does not create punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision authorizes Parliament to enact laws prescribing additional penalties and enforcement measures; it does not itself create or list punishable conduct or impose a penalty.

The provision establishes the Minerals Management Board and regulates its composition, appointments, functions, allowances, removal of members, and procedure. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision concerns the King's authority to appoint and remove diplomatic representatives and receive accredited envoys. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.
The provision authorises the Chief Justice to make rules regulating court practice, procedure, and judicial officers’ powers. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision regulates parliamentary procedure and authorizes Standing Orders. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe any penalty.

This section establishes the procedure for issuing infringement notices and paying prescribed fixed penalties for alleged offences. It does not itself create or list an offence or prescribe a penalty amount; it refers to noncompliance and penalties established elsewhere.

The provision establishes the procedure for bringing the Chancellor of Justice to criminal liability, requiring a proposal from the President and consent of a majority of Parliament. It does not create an offence or prescribe a penalty.
The provision makes failure to comply with requirements imposed on a licensee by this Part an offence and specifies fines and imprisonment upon conviction.
This provision restricts Parliament’s consideration of financial bills and motions without Cabinet consent. It establishes a legislative procedure, not an offence, infraction, or penalty.

The provision makes unauthorized alteration, interference, or manipulation of information in the National Register of Voters or its database an offence, punishable by a fine of up to $100,000, imprisonment for 10 years, or both.
The provision authorizes refusal of refugee status on national security and public safety grounds. It does not create or list an offence or prescribe a penalty.
Section 72 governs administration of the Act and the appointment, duties, and removal of inspectors and other officers. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision only defines “carry out” in relation to a radiation practice. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
This provision permits a court to vary instalment orders or time to pay an existing fine. It is a procedural rule and does not create punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

Subsection (1) makes specified unlicensed commercial dealings in arms or ammunition an offence. Subsection (10) criminalises contraventions of subsections (6)–(9), and subsection (11) makes dealing at an unlicensed place an offence.
The section imposes disclosure and participation duties on Board members and sets quorum and recordkeeping rules, but does not create or list an offence, infraction, or penalty for noncompliance.

The provision directly imposes sanctions for contravening the Code—dismissal or removal and disqualification from public office—and requires forfeiture of assets not reasonably attributable to a legitimate source, subject to due process.

The provision authorises a civil action against the State to recover damages for loss caused by the Registrar’s errors or misfeasance. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision defines when a bill is payable at a determinable future time and excludes contingent instruments from being bills. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.
This provision directs the judge to pronounce the divorce and decide its consequences when satisfied that both spouses freely consented. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.

The provision sets requirements for displaying and publishing nominations and prohibits changes to party lists or new nominations after nominations close. It does not create or list an offence, infraction, or penalty.

This provision lists the components of a professional qualification and allows them to be certified by professional competency certificates. “Sanctionnées” refers to certification, not punishment; no punishable conduct or penalty is established.
The provision authorises the Minister to apply sections of the Act to Fiji Development Bank in specified circumstances. It does not itself create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

The provision establishes the right to education, compulsory schooling, and rules on educational institutions, parental choice, language of instruction, and state supervision. It creates no offence or other punishable conduct and prescribes no penalty.
The provision prohibits specified nautical activities and sets out exceptions, but does not itself establish an offence, infraction, or penalty.

This provision grants amnesty for specified categories of existing offences committed before 28 April 1959. It neither creates punishable conduct nor prescribes a penalty; its list identifies offences covered by the amnesty.
Cette disposition proroge les mandats de membres et de dirigeants du Haut Conseil. Elle ne crée ni infraction ni sanction.
Le texte autorise la Caisse nationale des télécommunications à émettre un emprunt et en fixe le montant et la valeur nominale des obligations. Il ne crée aucune infraction ni aucune sanction.
This provision sets maximum annual amounts of an employment-related indemnity supplement. It does not create or list punishable conduct or impose a penalty.

Le texte impose seulement le reversement des aides indûment perçues à la suite de déclarations inexactes. Il ne crée pas d’infraction ni de peine et renvoie aux sanctions pénales et poursuites prévues par une autre disposition.

L’article organise la saisine de l’instance disciplinaire, les délais de décision et l’appel en cas de manquement d’un avocat à son serment. Il ne crée ni ne liste une infraction ou une sanction ; la mention d’une sanction disciplinaire encadre seulement la procédure applicable.

The provision states the Waste Management Code’s purpose and objectives, including waste prevention and protection of the environment and human health. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision governs an adopted person's personal and property rights and obligations toward biological parents and relatives. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.
La disposition renvoie à une annexe pour définir les catégories de données et informations enregistrées dans un traitement. Elle ne crée ni ne liste de conduite punissable ou de sanction.
Le texte détermine les dispositions statutaires applicables aux agents non titulaires, avec des exceptions et réserves. Il ne crée ni ne liste de conduite punissable ou de sanction.

The provision establishes state support for soldiers and citizens who lose their health while serving or defending the State, and for the families of those who die. It creates no offence, infraction, or penalty.
The provision establishes Parliament’s composition, members’ terms, electoral principles, and the threshold for Parliament to be considered elected. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.
The provision states that Lithuania’s territorial administrative units and their boundaries are determined by law. It does not create or list punishable conduct or any penalty.
This provision governs the Council of State’s advisory role and legislative procedures. It neither creates or lists punishable conduct nor establishes any penalty.
This provision establishes the principles of legality and non-retroactivity of offences and penalties. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

This provision guarantees individual liberty and establishes safeguards for arrest, detention, and criminal accusations, including the presumption of innocence. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

Cette disposition garantit la liberté d’opinion et de la presse et interdit la censure. Elle mentionne les infractions commises dans l’exercice de ces libertés, mais ne définit aucun comportement punissable et ne prévoit aucune peine.
This provision governs municipal taxes, budget-setting, accounts, and financial resources. It neither creates or lists punishable conduct nor establishes a penalty.

This provision delegates to legislation the conditions, limits, and implementation of public entities’ liability for damage caused in the exercise of public functions. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

This provision sets voting and eligibility requirements and permits courts to prohibit those rights in cases provided by law. It does not itself define punishable conduct or establish a penalty for any specified conduct.

This provision establishes legislative authorization requirements for State borrowing, property transactions, major projects, financial commitments, budgetary charges, and benefits. It creates no offence, infraction, or penalty.

This provision guarantees freedom of belief and worship and prohibits compulsion to participate in religious practices. Its reference to offences committed when exercising these freedoms does not create or list any offence or penalty.

L’article prévoit directement des sanctions pour les manquements aux dispositions de la loi, notamment une sanction pécuniaire, un avertissement et la cessation du traitement ou le retrait de l’autorisation.
This provision establishes incompatibilities between the mandate of deputy and certain other offices. It does not create or list an offence, infraction, or penalty.

L’article crée une infraction et prévoit une amende de 1 à 4 millions d’Ariary pour l’employeur qui, malgré une mise en demeure, rémunère un travailleur à la tâche, aux pièces, au rendement ou au « Target » en dessous du salaire de référence décrit. La peine est doublée en cas de récidive.
This article establishes vocational training as a worker’s right and a national duty, and defines its nature and objectives. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.

Cette disposition prévoit que les jours fériés et les jours « ponts » sont chômés et payés, et fixe les modalités d’établissement de leur liste annuelle. Elle ne crée aucune infraction et ne prévoit aucune sanction.
This provision grants the President the power to pardon and to confer decorations and honours. It does not create or list punishable conduct or establish a penalty.
Cette disposition détermine le tribunal territorialement compétent et répute non écrites les clauses contraires. Elle ne crée aucune infraction et ne prévoit aucune peine.

L’article crée une infraction pour le fait d’imposer à autrui un travail forcé ou obligatoire, défini et interdit à l’article 4, et prévoit un emprisonnement de trois mois à un an et/ou une amende d’un à quatre millions d’Ariary.
Subsection (2) expressly makes failure to comply with the prohibition on using public resources for election campaigning an offence.
Cette disposition fixe les conditions constitutionnelles des limitations aux libertés publiques. Elle ne crée ni ne liste de conduite punissable et ne prévoit aucune sanction.
La disposition fixe les sources des règles de fonctionnement de l’Assemblée nationale et impose la publication du règlement intérieur. Elle ne crée ni infraction ni sanction.

L’article crée une infraction pour le traitement de certaines données en violation des conditions légales et la punit de deux à cinq ans d’emprisonnement et d’une amende de 800 000 à 8 000 000 Ariary.
L’article définit la qualité de travailleur à domicile et renvoie aux conditions de cette qualification. Il ne crée ni ne liste de conduite punissable ou de sanction.

The provision establishes the right to life and clarifies that execution of a lawfully imposed death sentence is not arbitrary deprivation of life. It does not create or list an offence or impose a penalty.
The provision establishes and defines the Malawi Prisons Service and its constituent institutions. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
Le texte érige le non-respect du droit d’accès prévu à l’article 23 en infraction et le punit de deux à cinq ans d’emprisonnement et d’une amende de 800 000 à 8 000 000 Ariary.
The provision makes attempting any offence under this law punishable by the same penalties as the completed offence, thereby creating punishable conduct.
The provision establishes the Defence Force’s duties, civilian control, and deployment limits. It does not create or list an offence or infraction, or prescribe a penalty for contravention.

The provision establishes children's rights and defines a child as a person under eighteen. It does not create or list an offence, infraction, or penalty; its reference to punishment concerns children's right to protection from harmful treatment.
This provision sets out the procedure for replacing and cancelling a mistakenly marked ballot paper. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
This provision governs the appointment and tenure of Acting Justices of Appeal. It creates no punishable conduct and prescribes no penalty.
The provision prescribes voting procedures and duties for voters and polling officers. It does not create or list an offence, infraction, or penalty.
This provision repeals prior election laws and preserves existing subsidiary legislation. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe any penalty.
The provision governs winding up the National Compensation Fund, dissolving the Tribunal, and transferring jurisdiction over compensation claims. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.
The provision sets procedures for approving supplementary expenditure and appropriations. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
This provision sets procedures, voting thresholds, and consent requirements for constitutional amendments. It does not create or list any punishable conduct or penalty.
This provision establishes arrest powers and procedures for suspected offences under the Act. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
This provision authorizes the Commissioner to employ officers and servants. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

Subsection (2) makes failure to surrender the revoked certificate within seven days under subsection (1) an offence, punishable by a fine of up to two hundred thousand ringgit, imprisonment for up to two years, or both.
This provision authorizes and requires investigations into possible contraventions and applies investigation procedures. It does not itself create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision deems specified officials to be public servants within the meaning of the Penal Code. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
This provision prohibits forced exile and provides for asylum for certain persecuted persons. It does not create or list a punishable offence or establish a penalty.
The provision governs election-petition procedure and the High Court’s power to compel a return. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision requires written notification of a refusal to comply with a data access request within twenty-one days, but does not itself create or list an offence, infraction, or penalty.

This provision grants protection from suits, prosecutions, and other legal proceedings for acts or omissions done in good faith in specified official capacities. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

The provision sets electoral qualifications, disqualifications, and definitions. It references existing offences and sentences and prohibits voting in multiple constituencies, but does not itself designate conduct as an offence or prescribe a penalty.
Cet article définit la mission de veille citoyenne des organisations de la société civile et renvoie à la loi pour ses conditions d’exercice. Il ne crée ni infraction ni sanction.
The provision makes a judge’s breach of independence, impartiality, or integrity a serious professional offence punishable by disciplinary sanctions.
L’article définit les principes du suffrage et les conditions de qualité d’électeur. Il ne crée aucune infraction et ne prévoit aucune sanction.
The provision imposes a duty on the Commissioner to conserve the Fund but does not create or list an offence, infraction, or penalty.

This provision requires the State to protect children against human trafficking, related offences, and recruitment into violent extremist groups. It does not itself create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

This provision sets procedures and deadlines for parliamentary consideration of the finance bill and allows the Government to establish the budget if Parliament fails to act. It creates no offence, infraction, or penalty.

This provision guarantees the right to strike and requires its exercise within existing laws and regulations. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.

This provision excludes the application of certain Criminal Code and Probation Act provisions to existing offences. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision is repealed and contains no text creating or listing punishable conduct or a penalty.

L’article 55 règle l’obligation de déclaration des traitements de données de certains organismes publics et les pouvoirs de contrôle de l’Autorité. Il ne crée ni ne liste de conduite punissable et ne prévoit aucune sanction.

This provision authorizes eviction and removal of property on specified grounds and addresses court-permission requirements. It does not create an offence or infraction or prescribe a punitive penalty.

Article 16A(1) makes breaches of licence conditions or the Act, regulations, Investment Services Rules or Conduct of Business Rules, including failure to cooperate in an investigation, punishable by an administrative penalty of up to €150,000 for each infringement or failure to comply.
The provision specifies that the registrar shall administer certain oaths. It is a procedural rule and does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The text is a repealed provision heading and legislative history; it creates or lists no punishable conduct or penalty.
The provision excludes specified institutions from the applicability of this Part of the Act. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
This provision only states the title of the regulations. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision makes failure to draft judgments within the legally prescribed deadlines punishable by an administrative sanction.
The provision states that a tax exemption was repealed and includes a Part heading. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

The provision treats an already committed crime as accompanied by public violence when committed pursuant to a common design. It is a rule concerning punishment, not a provision creating or listing punishable conduct or prescribing a penalty.

El artículo establece prohibiciones y reglas sobre las asociaciones religiosas y sus ministros, pero no tipifica infracciones ni fija sanciones. La mención de las penas por faltar a la promesa de decir verdad remite a las que establece otra ley.

The provision establishes liability to court penalties for specified contraventions and authorises administrative penalties for specified failures to comply. La disposición establece criterios para fundar y motivar las resoluciones de la Secretaría; no crea ni enumera conductas sancionables ni fija penas. La mención de la infracción y la reincidencia no constituye por sí misma una tipificación.

The provision imposes lighting, reflector, and reflective-clothing requirements but does not itself declare a breach to be an offence or infraction or prescribe a penalty.

El artículo establece libertades, prohibiciones y límites constitucionales, pero no tipifica delitos o infracciones ni fija sanciones. La referencia al trabajo impuesto como pena no crea una pena, y el incumplimiento del contrato de trabajo sólo genera responsabilidad civil.

La disposición regula la jurisdicción federal sobre ciertos bienes inmuebles y exige consentimiento de la legislatura estatal para los adquiridos posteriormente. No tipifica conductas punibles ni establece sanciones.

El artículo identifica conductas que dan lugar a juicio político —violaciones graves a la Constitución y a las leyes federales y manejo indebido de fondos y recursos federales— y establece expresamente las sanciones de destitución e inhabilitación para el servicio público.
El artículo regula la sustitución provisional o interina del Presidente de la República y las licencias para separarse del cargo. No tipifica conductas punibles ni establece penas o sanciones.

El artículo establece obligaciones sobre la comunicación del aviso de privacidad, una excepción y la posibilidad de adoptar medidas compensatorias. No tipifica conductas como infracciones ni establece sanciones.
This section regulates how a receiver or fiduciary exercises powers and satisfies existing pecuniary penalty or confiscation orders. It does not create or list punishable conduct or impose a penalty.

El artículo regula el procedimiento de protección de datos ante la falta de respuesta a una solicitud ARCO y el cumplimiento de la resolución. No tipifica infracciones ni establece sanciones; los costos de reproducción y envío son obligaciones de cumplimiento, no multas.

Establece plazos y requisitos para responder y hacer efectivas las solicitudes de derechos ARCO, así como la posibilidad de ampliar esos plazos. No tipifica conductas sancionables ni establece penas o multas.
Subsection (4) makes failure to comply with the registration requirements a misdemeanor, and subsection (5) sets a penalty of imprisonment for not more than one year.
The provision creates the offense of child trafficking by specifying prohibited conduct and establishes penalties of up to 30 years’ imprisonment, a $5,000–$50,000 fine, or both.

The provision creates the crime of trespassing by defining prohibited conduct—knowingly entering or remaining unlawfully on another person’s property—and prescribes imprisonment of up to three years in specified circumstances or up to one year otherwise.

Subsection (1) defines the crime of bribery by specifying prohibited conduct, and subsection (3) imposes up to ten years’ imprisonment and disqualification from holding a National Government position.
El artículo regula esquemas de autorregulación y exige que incluyan consecuencias y medidas correctivas ante incumplimientos, pero no tipifica conductas punibles ni establece penas o sanciones.

This provision establishes procedures for seizure, detention, and release of currency suspected of being connected to a serious offense. It does not create or list an offense or prescribe a penalty; its references to criminal proceedings and confiscation concern offenses and processes established elsewhere.
This provision sets criteria for classifying a substance in Schedule V. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision authorizes the Secretary to issue, amend, and repeal implementing regulations; it does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

The provision creates a crime for public officials who acquire pecuniary interests, speculate or wager, or assist others based on contemplated official action or nonpublic official information. It also prescribes imprisonment of up to ten years and disqualification from National Government positions.
The provision establishes the parliamentary procedure for expressing no confidence in the Government. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision defines the representative mandate of deputies and declares any imperative mandate null. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
This provision authorizes regulations creating additional exceptions and requires notice to congressional committees. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision regulates the establishment of taxes and public revenues and prohibits other levies, but does not create or list an offence or prescribe a penalty.

The provision establishes reporting, hearing, and recommendation procedures for changes to controlled-substance schedules and assigns scheduling authority to Congress. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision establishes constitutional principles of democracy and political pluralism and prohibits an official state ideology. It does not create or list an offence, infraction, or penalty.

The provision establishes a duty of loyalty and faithful performance of obligations for public officials and military personnel, including an oath where required by law. It does not create or list any punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision governs court funding, consultation on court budgets, judges’ remuneration and rights, and police support for courts. It creates no offence, infraction, or penalty.
The provision governs validation of the presidential election result and the deadline and wording for the oath of office. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.

The provision governs judges’ status, appointment, immunity, and incompatibilities. Paragraph (6) merely states that judges are sanctioned in accordance with the law; it does not itself define punishable conduct or establish a penalty.

The provision establishes incompatibilities and parliamentary immunity, including procedural conditions for detaining, arresting, searching, or prosecuting a deputy. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

Textul stabilește componența Curții Constituționale, durata mandatului judecătorilor, autoritățile care îi numesc și alegerea președintelui. Nu creează sau enumeră fapte sancționabile și nu prevede pedepse.
The provision governs interpretation of constitutional human rights and gives international human-rights rules priority over conflicting domestic laws. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.

This provision establishes internal reporting procedures, confidentiality requirements, and protections for whistleblowers, including an exemption from criminal liability. It does not itself create or list an offence, infraction, or penalty.

Cet article impose des obligations de collecte, de conservation et de transmission d’informations concernant les transferts de fonds, mais ne crée ni ne liste une infraction et ne prévoit aucune sanction.

The provision criminalizes disclosure of information identifying the reporting person or the person implicated in a report, prescribing three years’ imprisonment and a fine for natural persons, and penalties for criminally responsible legal persons.

This provision describes the princely and national flags and refers to the Sovereign Ordinance of 4 April 1881 for rules governing their use. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

This article establishes the Autorité monégasque de sécurité financière and describes its functions, consultation procedures, reporting duties and guidance. It merely refers to its sanctioning function under another chapter; it does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
L’article impose des obligations d’abstention et de déclaration concernant certaines opérations suspectes, mais ne qualifie pas leur violation d’infraction et ne prévoit aucune peine ou sanction.

The provision criminalizes preventing or attempting to prevent the specified controls and prescribes imprisonment of one to six months and/or a fine. It also establishes penalties for legal persons held criminally responsible.

L’article garantit des libertés et interdit la contrainte en matière de culte. Il mentionne la répression des délits commis dans l’exercice de ces libertés, mais ne crée ni ne liste aucune infraction ou peine.
This provision regulates personal-data processing, retention, deletion, and sharing between authorities. It does not create or list punishable conduct or establish any penalty.

Cette disposition fixe les conditions d’éligibilité au Conseil National et renvoie à la loi pour les causes d’inéligibilité et les incompatibilités. Elle ne crée ni ne liste de conduite punissable ou de sanction.

The provision establishes regional and local government structures and the Council of Traditional Leaders. It creates no offence, infraction, or penalty.

This provision establishes procedures for objections to liquidation accounts, directions to amend accounts, court review, and inspection of amended accounts. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

The provision establishes requirements for the timing, method, location, and documentation of remuneration payments, but does not itself declare any conduct an offence or infraction or prescribe a penalty.
The provision defines the crime of murder by specifying punishable conduct and establishes imprisonment of at least ten years, with a possible life sentence.
This provision prohibits anonymous accounts, savings books and safe-deposit boxes, but does not itself classify that conduct as an offence or infraction or prescribe a penalty.
The provision governs when an arrangement binds a company and its creditors and provides for court review. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.
The provision sets out the powers of Regional Councils. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe any penalty.
The provision authorizes the Registrar or Court to order a change of name and sets procedures and time limits. It does not create an offence or infraction or prescribe a penalty.
The provision imposes record-keeping and inspection duties on a liquidator but does not create or list an offence, infraction, or penalty for noncompliance.
The provision establishes the evidentiary status of a company’s register of members; it does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

Article 446a creates an offence for failing to promptly notify a competent public prosecutor of specified information or seek the prosecutor’s instructions after the listed actions. It prescribes detention of up to three months or a second-category fine.
The provision regulates share allotment and payment and makes certain allotments or agreements void. It does not create an offence or infraction or impose a punitive penalty.
The provision identifies unfair labour practices and governs disclosure disputes and arbitration remedies. It does not create an offence or administrative infraction, or prescribe a punitive penalty.

Article 344a criminalizes intentional failures to provide, maintain, or preserve required administrative records in bankruptcy or debt restructuring proceedings, and prescribes imprisonment of up to four years or a fifth-category fine.

Article 227c criminalizes intentionally providing false information or failing to provide required information where this causes EU budget funds or assets to be unlawfully received or retained, or EU budget resources to be reduced. Article 137e criminalizes publishing specified insulting or hate-inciting statements and distributing or possessing objects containing them for publication or distribution. It prescribes imprisonment or fines, with higher penalties for habitual or professional offending or offences committed by two or more persons acting together.

Paragraph 1 expressly makes an attempted crime punishable when the perpetrator’s intent manifests itself through a beginning of execution. The remaining paragraphs specify the applicable penalties for attempts.

This provision governs the appointment and powers of two administrators and judicial resolution of disagreements between them, including allocation of remuneration. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.

This provision defines parties to civil-status records, regulates representation, and prohibits the registrar from executing a record in which they are a party. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

The provision sets a registration requirement and deadline for exercising a matrimonial-property privilege. Failure results in loss of that privilege, not an offence, fine, or administrative infraction.

This provision establishes when prosecution for insult requires a complaint and provides exceptions to that requirement. It is procedural and does not itself create punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

This provision regulates the civil-law effects of changing the recorded sex and first names, including existing family relationships and parentage or adoption. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.
The provision defines the Act’s scope of application. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision establishes minimum rights in criminal proceedings, including sentencing and appeal protections. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
This provision sets commencement dates for the Act. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

The provision makes committing, aiding, abetting, inciting, counselling, or procuring an offence grounds for criminal guilt, and extends liability to specified offences committed in pursuing a common unlawful purpose.
The provision establishes a right against non-consensual medical or scientific experimentation but does not create or list an offence, infraction, or penalty.

The provision directly criminalises making false documents with specified intentions and knowingly making false documents available without reasonable excuse. Subsections (1), (2), and (5) prescribe imprisonment of up to 10 or 3 years.

The provision authorizes the Solicitor-General to perform the Attorney-General’s functions, duties, and powers. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
This provision sets out the Commission’s powers, including the power to investigate violations and impose penalties. It does not itself create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

The provision requires agencies to appoint privacy officers and specifies their responsibilities and an exception. It does not create or list an offence or other punishable conduct, or prescribe a penalty.
The provision states the purpose of the subpart—authorising information sharing to facilitate public services. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

This provision establishes and funds the Commission’s Fund. It merely identifies collected penalties and fines as sources of funding; it does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

Subsection (2) expressly makes contraventions of specified conflict-of-interest duties an offence and prescribes fines and imprisonment on conviction, notwithstanding the inconsistent paragraph references.

This provision authorises the Commission to make regulations that may create offences and impose penalties, but does not itself create or list punishable conduct or impose a penalty. Its references to fines and penalties concern regulatory powers and penalties prescribed elsewhere.
The provision authorizes the Minister to issue directives and requires the Commission to comply. It does not create or list an offence, infraction, or penalty.

This provision establishes exemptions from the Act and authorizes regulations and guidance concerning exempt processing. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty; references to criminal offences and penalties describe purposes of exempt processing.
The provision governs staff pensions, retirement benefits, and the Council’s pension-related powers. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

The provision authorises sanctions for violations of the Act or subsidiary legislation, including monetary penalties, and sets maximum amounts of N10,000,000 or N2,000,000, respectively, or 2% of annual gross revenue, whichever is greater.
The provision grants indemnity for official-duty liabilities and certain criminal or civil proceedings. It does not create or list punishable conduct or impose a penalty.
The provision governs the King’s power to pardon convicted offenders and limits pardons in impeachment cases. It neither creates punishable conduct nor establishes a penalty.

The provision imposes cross-border transfer restrictions and recordkeeping duties and authorizes regulations, but does not itself designate violations as offences or infractions or prescribe a penalty.

The provision establishes consent and verification duties for processing children's data or data of persons lacking legal capacity, with exceptions and regulatory authority. It does not itself create or list an offence, infraction, or penalty.
The provision identifies the ordinary courts and states that they hear and decide civil and criminal cases. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision governs appointment of Council members and their qualifications. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision establishes rights to natural justice, judicial review, and civil proceedings involving the Crown. It does not create or list any punishable conduct or penalty.
The provision defines deceased estates and estate administration, sets conditions for private or public administration, and requires proportionate costs. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.

The provision establishes constitutional rights and prohibitions concerning life, capital punishment, torture, slavery and forced labour, and imposes protective duties on state authorities. It does not itself create an offence or prescribe a penalty.
The provision governs the Supreme Court’s jurisdiction, composition, appointment age, and finality of judgments. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.

The provision establishes constitutional safeguards concerning legality, punishment by judgment, the presumption of innocence, and limits on confiscation. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
This provision establishes an affirmative defense of entrapment and limits its availability. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

The provision permits testamentary disinheritance of a descendant who has committed a qualifying criminal offence. It neither creates an offence nor prescribes a penalty; it sets inheritance consequences by reference to offences punishable under other provisions.

This provision assigns enforcement authority and establishes jurisdiction and application rules for crimes created elsewhere in the chapter. It does not itself create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision establishes constitutional rights and prohibitions and requires state authorities to protect them. It does not create or list punishable offences or prescribe penalties.
The provision establishes the number of parliamentary representatives and rules for allocating seats among electoral districts. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.

This provision establishes which law prevails when other criminal procedure statutes conflict with this chapter. It mentions penalties but does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
This provision sets sentencing rules for a person already convicted of a class A felony, including the imprisonment range and prohibition on suspension. It does not create or list punishable conduct.
The provision creates the offense of knowingly transmitting a false alarm of fire or another emergency to specified emergency-response entities and classifies it as a misdemeanor.

The provision describes the purpose of public estate administration, including identifying assets, liabilities and heirs, distributing the estate, and managing its assets responsibly. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.
The provision imposes a duty to inform Parliament and prohibits ministers from providing false or misleading information, but does not itself establish an offence or prescribe a penalty.
The provision subjects specified chemicals and related facilities to verification measures under the Convention; it does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision establishes procedures for de-listing and determining whether freezing measures apply or may be revoked. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

The provision governs the King’s appointment of civil and military officials, their duty of loyalty and obedience, and the exclusion of royal princes and princesses from civil office. It creates no offence or penalty.
The provision designates the national anthem and requires attestation and deposit of its official copy. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.

This provision establishes judicial forfeiture procedures, including notice, claims, hearings, burdens of proof, and court orders. It applies only where forfeiture is authorized by other law and does not itself create or list punishable conduct or its penalty.
This provision defines prima facie evidence and specifies the evidentiary rules governing it. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

This provision establishes an affirmative defense of renunciation for attempt, solicitation, and conspiracy and defines its requirements. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision only establishes the chapter’s short title; it does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

The provision authorizes the President to make regulations and delegate those powers. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe any penalty.
The provision authorizes the Minister to make regulations concerning standards for homes and childcare institutions; it does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

The provision sets age, registration, eligibility, and certification requirements for day-care centres and crèches. It does not create or list an offence or other punishable conduct, or prescribe a penalty.
The provision designates ward tribunals and certain community bodies as Marriage Conciliation Boards. It creates no offence, punishable conduct, or penalty.
Section 149 makes an employer’s failure to comply with the listed provisions a regulatory infraction punishable by a regulatory fine of up to 10,000 baht.

This provision establishes procedures for constitutional amendments, including proposal requirements, voting thresholds, referendums, and Constitutional Court review. It does not create or list any punishable conduct or penalty.
This provision establishes the composition, authority, and procedures of the committee selecting Constitutional Court judges. It creates no offence, punishable conduct, or penalty.

This provision sets principles for drafting, reviewing, and administering laws, including limiting criminal penalties to serious offences. It does not itself create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision only sets the royal decree’s effective date as the day after publication in the Royal Gazette. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.

This provision sets grounds for termination of Senate membership, including disqualification, excessive absence, final imprisonment judgments, and violations of other provisions. It does not itself create or list offences, administrative infractions, or their penalties.

This provision sets out when membership of the House of Representatives ends, including disqualification, prohibited acts, excessive absence, and a final prison sentence. It does not create or list offences or prescribe criminal or administrative penalties; termination of parliamentary membership is a status consequence.

This provision requires employers temporarily suspending operations to pay employees at least 75% of their wages and give employees and labour inspectors advance written notice. It does not itself designate an offence or infraction or prescribe a penalty.
Section 145 makes an employer’s failure to comply with section 23, paragraph one or three, a regulatory infraction punishable by a fine of up to 5,000 baht.

This provision authorizes parliamentary rules governing proceedings, ethics, and committee composition, including representation requirements for certain special committees. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

This provision governs appeals against labour inspectors’ orders, their effect on compliance, and termination of criminal proceedings upon timely compliance. It does not itself create or list an offence or prescribe a penalty.

L’article 240 règle les fonctions des contrôleurs du travail, la constatation des infractions, la délégation de pouvoirs et la prestation de serment. Il ne crée ni ne liste de conduite punissable et ne fixe aucune sanction.

L’article crée des infractions pour la sous-traitance des contrats de tâcheronnat et le rachat ou transfert de contrats de travail en cours par des entreprises ou établissements de placement. Il prévoit une amende de 500 000 à 2 000 000 francs CFA et/ou un emprisonnement de six mois à deux ans, avec doublement en cas de récidive.

L’article 40 prévoit la délivrance d’une copie des données, un paiement limité au coût de reproduction et des mesures préventives contre leur dissimulation ou disparition. Il ne crée ni ne liste aucune infraction ou sanction.

L’article 22 énumère des exceptions à l’interdiction de traitement prévue à l’article 21. Il ne crée ni ne liste une infraction ou une sanction ; la mention d’une infraction pénale concerne une finalité autorisée de traitement des données génétiques.
Article 343 lists punishable conduct in paragraphs (a)–(i) and directly imposes fines of 100,000–500,000 CFA francs, increased to 500,000–2,000,000 CFA francs for repeat offences.

Cet article fixe les règles de calcul de la rémunération pendant le congé payé, des indemnités de licenciement et des dommages et intérêts, et définit les remboursements de frais. Il ne crée ni ne liste de conduite punissable ou de sanction.
L’article 344 énumère des conduites punissables (a à h) et leur impose une amende de 100 000 à 500 000 francs CFA, portée à 500 000 à 2 000 000 francs CFA en cas de récidive.
L’article définit le statut, la tutelle et les missions de l’ANPE. Il ne crée ni ne liste aucun comportement punissable et ne prévoit aucune sanction.
L’article 189 habilite le ministre à fixer les travaux interdits aux femmes enceintes et encadre ces interdictions. Il ne crée ni ne liste d’infraction punissable et ne prévoit aucune sanction.
L’article 337 définit les circonstances dans lesquelles le lock-out est exceptionnellement admis, sans créer d’infraction ni prévoir de sanction.
