This provision governs the execution of an existing aggravated life sentence, including confinement, activities, visits, and medical care. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty for an offence.

This provision governs procedural requests to revoke detention and release suspects under judicial supervision or when detention is no longer necessary. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision governs the use of school revolving funds under the joint responsibility of designated officials. It does not create or list an offence, infraction, or penalty.

Article 257 criminalizes abuse of public office: acting contrary to official duties or neglecting or delaying those duties, causing individual hardship, public harm, or unjust benefit. It prescribes imprisonment of six months to two years under paragraph (1), and three months to one year under paragraph (2).

The provision governs limitation periods for tax assessment, their suspension and commencement, and the revival of stamp-tax liability. It mentions a time-barred penalty but does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

This provision lists the duties and powers of the Personnel Department, including personnel planning, employment administration, and training. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe any penalty.

The provision lists sources of income for the named institutions, such as budget assistance, donations, bequests, and investment income. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe any penalty.

The provision creates an offence of wilfully and unlawfully killing, maiming or wounding an animal capable of being stolen. It classifies the offence as a felony for specified animals, punishable by seven years’ imprisonment, and as a misdemeanour in other cases.

The provision governs application of penalties already established elsewhere: it conditions their application to children’s associations on repetition after written warning, defines who counts as an association manager, and designates the authority competent to impose administrative sanctions. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

The provision establishes the duties and powers of the General Directorate of Water Management and requires public institutions to provide water-related data upon request. It does not create or list any punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision creates a felony for taking, concealing, or otherwise disposing of ore, metal, or minerals in or about a mine with intent to defraud, and prescribes five years’ imprisonment.
The provision only notes that amendments to Articles 1, 4, and 5 of Law No. 6207 have been incorporated into that law. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
Subsection (1) creates the offence of inciting violence against a person on specified grounds and prescribes imprisonment for up to fourteen years.
The provision permits pending court proceedings to continue and be completed. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

The provision creates an offence of aiding, abetting, or being accessory to mutiny, or inciting specified armed forces members or police officers to disobey a lawful superior order, punishable by up to five years’ imprisonment.
The provision creates a misdemeanour for inducing acts involving a valuable security by false pretence with intent to defraud, and prescribes imprisonment for five years on conviction.

The provision expressly makes the listed conduct involving damage, interference, nuisance, trespass, or obstruction relating to railway works an offence, punishable by a fine of 120 currency points or five years’ imprisonment.
This provision defines kidnapping from lawful guardianship but does not itself declare the conduct an offence or prescribe a penalty.

The provision establishes and regulates traditional or cultural leadership, including prohibitions on compelled allegiance, partisan politics, and exercising governmental powers. It does not designate any conduct as an offence or infraction or prescribe a penalty.
The provision prohibits employers from requiring overtime or holiday work in hazardous jobs, but does not itself designate a punishable offence or prescribe a penalty.

The provision creates a misdemeanour offence for adulterating a drug or medical preparation with the specified effects and intent or knowledge that it will be sold or used medicinally as if unadulterated.

The provision authorizes compensatory damages in a civil action for unlawful or negligent destruction of protected wildlife and sets recovery procedures and exceptions. It does not create an offence or prescribe a punitive penalty; its mentions of civil or administrative penalties do not independently impose them.

This provision establishes the functions, independence, reporting duties, and regulatory authority of the Public Service Commission. Although it authorizes disciplinary control over public officers, it does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision directs the department to consider specified education requirements when approving driver instruction and training. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.
This provision only defines terms used in the article; it does not create or list punishable conduct or impose a penalty.
The provision permits legislators to take the oath of office later during their elected term. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.
The provision establishes a duty to provide necessities and attributes harmful consequences to a failure to perform that duty. It does not itself create or list an offence or prescribe a penalty.
This provision authorizes board approval of security interests in corporate property and generally dispenses with member approval. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.
This provision establishes a procedure for determining and enforcing contribution or repayment liability among judgment debtors. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision requires directors to hold an organization meeting and elect officers, and allows the commissioner to extend the deadline. It does not create or list an offence, infraction, or penalty.
This provision specifies which bankruptcy chapters and subchapters apply to particular cases. It does not create or list punishable conduct or establish any penalty.
The provision only establishes the chapter’s short title. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

This provision governs the legal effect of reissued patents and protects intervening rights, including equitable relief for pre-reissue activities. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

This provision governs waiver of sovereign immunity, court authority, and enforcement of judgments in bankruptcy. It does not create or list punishable conduct or a penalty; it expressly excludes punitive damages and creates no new substantive cause of action.
This provision governs the issuance of patent reexamination certificates and the effect of amended or new patent claims. It does not create or list punishable conduct or impose a penalty.

The provision prescribes requirements for fishery management plans, including review and amendment procedures and specification of regulatory authority. It does not create or list punishable conduct or establish a penalty.

The provision defines “writing,” requires certain documents to be written in English, and permits certified mail in place of registered mail. It does not create or list an offence, infraction, or penalty.

The provision makes failure to comply with a commission or commissioner order, decision, rule, regulation, direction, demand, or requirement punishable as contempt. It creates the punishable conduct and specifies punishment by reference to contempt sanctions imposed by courts of record.
This provision grants bankruptcy trustees creditor and purchaser rights and powers to avoid certain transfers or obligations. It does not create or list punishable conduct or impose a penalty.

The provision assigns fact-finding and evaluation of evidence to the jury. It is a procedural rule and creates no punishable conduct or penalty.

The provision extends Fair Labor Standards Act protections to covered employees and provides a civil damages remedy by reference to that Act. It does not create or list an offence, administrative infraction, fine, or other punitive penalty.
The provision only defines terms used in the chapter; it creates no punishable conduct and prescribes no penalty.

The provision addresses the relationship to other laws, preserves existing rights and remedies, and establishes state-law preemption. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

The provision establishes priority based on an earlier foreign design-registration filing if the U.S. application is filed within six months. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision specifies formal requirements for issuing and recording patents. It does not create or list punishable conduct or impose a penalty.
Regula el cumplimiento de las penas privativas de libertad y las facultades del tribunal, remitiéndose a otras normas. No crea ni enumera conductas punibles ni establece una pena.
La disposición regula la remisión de deudas, sus formas expresa y tácita, y no establece conductas punibles ni sanciones.

Establece requisitos procesales para la acción de nulidad: agotar la vía administrativa y presentar la acción dentro del plazo legal. La caducidad por presentación tardía no constituye una infracción ni una sanción punitiva.

El artículo tipifica y castiga la comercialización o venta de sustancias genuinas peligrosas para la salud por quien no está legalmente habilitado o contraviene disposiciones reglamentarias. Aunque remite a «la misma pena», crea directamente la conducta punible.

La disposición exige valorar separadamente la ganancia esperada en la póliza e identificar los efectos correspondientes, bajo consecuencia de nulidad. Esa nulidad no constituye una pena ni tipifica una conducta punible.
Regula la venta de efectos averiados y la determinación de su precio para el cálculo. No tipifica conductas punibles ni establece penas, multas o infracciones.
This provision establishes procedural rules for SIPC applications, stays of bankruptcy proceedings, and dismissal of the case. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

La disposición solo remite al artículo 102 del Código Penal para aplicar el régimen de vigilancia de la autoridad impuesto por una sentencia; no crea ni enumera conductas punibles ni establece una pena.
La disposizione disciplina la pubblicazione, l’entrata in vigore e la conservazione delle leggi; non crea né elenca condotte punibili o sanzioni.
La disposizione attribuisce allo Stato e al Governatorato competenze relative a dotazioni, infrastrutture, servizi e forniture; non individua condotte punibili né stabilisce sanzioni.
El artículo regula las demandas civiles que pueden interponerse contra el heredero pese a la dilación concedida. No crea ni enumera conductas punibles ni establece sanciones.

The provision governs judicial authority, proceedings, and sentencing principles. It neither creates nor lists punishable conduct or a specific penalty; its mention of punishment concerns rehabilitation and restoration of legal order.

La disposición regula la oportunidad y las condiciones para celebrar un acuerdo reparatorio entre el imputado y la víctima. Es una norma procesal que no crea ni enumera conductas punibles ni establece penas.
The provision replaces the previous Fundamental Law, repeals conflicting rules and customs, and establishes immediate entry into force. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.

La disposizione rinvia al Codice penale e ad altre leggi per gli illeciti e le sanzioni, e disciplina la sostituzione e la determinazione delle pene. Non crea né elenca condotte punibili o relative pene.

El artículo establece una pena de penitenciaría de quince a treinta años para el homicidio cometido en las circunstancias específicas que enumera, incluido el femicidio. Por tanto, tipifica modalidades agravadas de conducta punible y fija su pena.
La disposizione identifica i soggetti appartenenti alla comunità dello Stato; non crea né elenca condotte punibili o sanzioni.
La disposizione disciplina le funzioni del Vice Segretario Generale e la sostituzione del Segretario Generale; non crea né elenca condotte punibili o sanzioni.

La disposición prohíbe actividades en competencia, pero únicamente remite a la responsabilidad prevista en el artículo 83. No tipifica una infracción punible ni establece una pena o multa; la expresión «bajo pena» alude aquí a responsabilidad societaria.
The provision prohibits lending or permitting use of a frank, subject to exceptions, but does not classify the conduct as an offence or infraction or prescribe a penalty.
La disposición establece supuestos en los que no pueden imponerse sanciones por seguir una interpretación tributaria consultada. No crea ni enumera conductas punibles ni establece una pena.
La disposizione disciplina il recepimento suppletivo della legislazione italiana e le condizioni per la sua applicabilità nella Città del Vaticano; non crea né elenca condotte punibili o sanzioni.
The provision establishes budget oversight and auditing by a three-member board. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
La disposición establece requisitos para autorizar un matrimonio y exige declaraciones juradas sobre los hijos y sus bienes. No tipifica conductas punibles ni establece una pena o sanción.
La disposizione disciplina i poteri del giudice nelle controversie civili in assenza di una norma applicabile; non crea né elenca condotte punibili o sanzioni.
La disposizione richiama il Codice di procedura civile vaticano e le successive modificazioni per disciplinare il rito civile; non crea né elenca condotte punibili o sanzioni.

La disposición regula la responsabilidad sobre los centros para adolescentes y sus condiciones de atención y seguridad. Solo menciona las sanciones penales aplicadas conforme a la ley especial; no crea ni enumera conductas punibles ni establece penas.
La disposizione stabilisce l'obbligo scolastico e le modalità per adempierlo, ma non qualifica alcuna condotta come illecito né prevede sanzioni.
El artículo establece la organización federal descentralizada del Estado y sus principios rectores; no crea ni enumera conductas punibles ni establece penas.
La disposición establece una regla probatoria para determinar tributos o imponer sanciones. No crea ni enumera conductas punibles ni fija una pena.
La disposición regula la interrupción de la prescripción de la pena; no crea ni enumera conductas punibles ni establece una sanción.
Regula la promoción y admisibilidad de pruebas en un recurso. La expresión «so pena de inadmisibilidad» establece una consecuencia procesal, no una infracción ni una sanción punitiva.
La disposición regula el sistema penitenciario, la rehabilitación y las modalidades de cumplimiento de penas. No tipifica conductas punibles ni establece sanciones.
La disposición únicamente define cuándo existe estado de guerra a efectos de determinados títulos; no crea ni enumera conductas punibles ni establece penas.
Subsection (1) makes inciting a person or organisation to commit terrorism or proliferation an offence and prescribes life imprisonment on conviction.

Regula las oportunidades y condiciones para la declaración del imputado, incluido el derecho a abstenerse y la nulidad de la declaración sin defensor. Es una norma procesal que no crea ni enumera conductas punibles ni establece penas.
La disposición establece plazos y deberes procesales del Ministerio Público para concluir la investigación y dictar el acto conclusivo. No crea ni enumera conductas punibles ni establece penas.
La disposición regula el efecto extensivo de un recurso entre varios imputados o en delitos conexos. Es una regla procesal y no crea conductas punibles ni establece sanciones.
El artículo 508 enumera atribuciones administrativas del juez presidente o jueza presidenta del Circuito; no crea ni lista conductas punibles ni establece penas o sanciones.

Subsection (1) creates an offence of embezzling or pilfering chemical, biological, radiological or nuclear material. Subsection (2) also prescribes imprisonment penalties for natural persons.
Subsection (2) expressly makes controlling or processing personal data without registration an offence and prescribes a fine, imprisonment, or both.

The provision establishes the Constitutional Court’s jurisdiction, referral procedure, right to petition for redress, and finality of decisions. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
This provision sets out post-conviction sentencing powers, including forfeiture, deletion, and prohibitions on processing personal data. It does not create or list punishable conduct.
The provision authorises the Committee to delegate its functions. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision establishes citizenship by birth and presumptions about nationality and place of birth. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.
The provision vests land in the President and sets conditions and procedures for its alienation and administration. It does not create or list any offence, infraction, or penalty.

The provision governs the President’s powers to constitute, abolish and classify public service offices and make appointments. It creates no offence or other punishable conduct and prescribes no penalty.

The provision establishes restrictions, consent requirements, and exceptions for processing sensitive data, but does not itself designate any breach as an offence or infraction or prescribe a penalty.
The provision imposes duties and prohibits certain conduct by security services and their members, but does not designate that conduct as an offence or infraction or prescribe a penalty.
The provision establishes the Gender Equity and Equality Commission and sets out its functions. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe any penalty.
The provision preserves existing rights to use or occupy agricultural land under State leases or agreements. It does not create or list punishable conduct or impose a penalty.

The provision establishes parliamentary privileges and immunities and authorises an Act to define contempt. It limits the punishments such an Act may permit but does not itself define punishable conduct or impose a penalty.
The provision specifies licence conditions and validity. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

This provision regulates the election, qualifications, duties and removal of council chairpersons. It mentions conviction of an offence and unlawful conduct as grounds for removal, but does not itself create or list offences or prescribe a penalty.
The provision establishes duties to promote culture, protect heritage, and respect traditional institutions. It does not create or list any punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

The provision establishes the right to life and constitutional limits on laws permitting the death penalty. It does not itself create an offence or prescribe a penalty; it sets sentencing restrictions and requires legislation concerning unborn children and termination of pregnancy.
The provision governs parliamentary voting procedures and rights to sit and speak in Parliament. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.
This provision sets conditions for vacating a parliamentary seat, including consequences of convictions under other laws. It does not create or list offences, infractions, or their penalties.

The provision sets consent requirements and exceptions for processing non-sensitive personal data. It does not create or list an offence, infraction, or penalty; the reference to proving an offence is only an exception permitting processing without consent.
The provision grants courts inherent powers to regulate their processes and develop common or customary law. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision establishes a right to personal liberty and limits detention and imprisonment. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
